The main takeaway from our work is that
many IR effectiveness experiments are underpowered, and that many IR researchers fail to report on significance testing.

IR researchers should be more aware of the need for statistical significance and power analysis, as well as the need for reporting test statistics (p-values and effect sizes) and confidence intervals.
